name: torus
description: Persistent research knowledge graph: recalls prior theses and claims when you mention a company, and records new research as you work.

capture_mode.title: Capture mode
capture_mode.description: Who writes research into the graph. balanced: Claude records theses and key claims, a curator fills in the rest after the session. live: Claude records everything as it goes (best quality, more usage). curator: Claude records only theses; the curator extracts the rest (least usage).
